note: Steps appear only when their real screenshot file exists in this folder. Nothing is drawn or mocked. See docs/marketing-screenshots.md in the desktop repo for the shot list.

steps.title: Choose how much it does
steps.caption: Switch between approving every message yourself and letting Raptor send to addresses companies published. Set daily budgets, follow-ups, and whether it may prepare LinkedIn and WhatsApp messages.

steps.title: Review what it wrote
steps.caption: Every message waits here in approval mode, with the address, the reason it was held and the full text. Approve or reject each one.

steps.title: See who it chose, and why
steps.caption: One row per prospect: the contact Raptor picked, whether the address was published, inferred or guessed, where it came from, and where each channel stands.

steps.title: Answer with a draft ready
steps.caption: Each reply is sorted by what it needs from you, with a draft written from your company facts only. Edit it, send it, or offer real times from your calendar.

steps.title: See how it scores
steps.caption: How many signals Raptor reads, whether it is on starting weights or has learned from your outcomes, and how far it is from enough results to learn.

steps.title: Check your sending domain
steps.caption: A read-only check of SPF, DKIM, DMARC and mail servers for the domain you send from, with what to fix.
